caption: The drawing features three main renderings of a single object and a detail. The central object is a long-handled tool with a flat, rectangular head that has an ornate cut-out pattern. The handle is depicted in grey and black tones and ends in a yellowish-golden, turned wooden grip with symmetrical curves and rings. Above the tool, the drawing includes a close-up of the handle, colored in the same yellowish-golden hue, highlighting its shape and carved details. To the left, there is a line drawing of the same flat, rectangular head and part of the handle, rendered in grayscale without color, showing the dimensions and cut-out pattern in a simplified form. The background is plain, and the entire composition is organized within a large rectangular border drawn on the page.
title: Fire Shovel
